description.en:
Set how quickly your cow sheds produce manure and liquid manure. Straw consumption scales at the same rate.
In the in-game Settings page you'll find a new row, "Husbandry Production Rate" - pick 1x, 2x, 3x, 5x, or 10x. The choice is saved per-savegame and applies on the next in-game hour.
Plays nicely with Realistic Livestock - the two mods touch different parts of the husbandry pipeline and don't conflict.
Cows only. Works in singleplayer and in multiplayer (host-authoritative - the host applies the rate and syncs it to every client).
